name: mapchange-coop-rec
description: A Wake co-op round played to its end (about 13 min), then the server's next round, with the server-side recorder preloaded: exercises the recorder's one-file-per-round split. The server stayed on Wake for the second round rather than moving to El Alamein, and serverTicketRatio does not shorten a co-op round (tickets still start at 200).
human: No client needed. Stop once the second file has opened (about 14 min in).
